title: Ohne-Makler Property Search Scraper
description: Find German property listings on Ohne-Makler with prices, rooms, area, location, coordinates, and listing links. Batch city searches and page through local results.

locations.title: German locations
locations.description: City, postal code, county, or state names to resolve on Ohne-Makler.

q.title: Search text
q.description: Free-text location: postal code (80331), city (München), Kreis, or Bundesland. Results are limited to the resolved place (returned as location). State/city segments are not accepted alongside q.

type.title: Type
type.description: Property type slug: wohnung, haus, grundstueck, zimmer, buero, einzelhandel, gastronomie, lagerhalle, landwirtschaftliches-objekt, wohnen-auf-zeit, gewerbliche-freizeitimmobilie, zinshaus-rendite, sonstiges, immobilie. Required unless q is used.

transaction.title: Transaction
transaction.description: kaufen (buy) or mieten (rent). Required unless q is used.

state.title: State
state.description: Bundesland URL slug (transliterated umlauts, e.g. baden-wurttemberg). Omit for a Germany-wide class.

city.title: City
city.description: City or Kreis URL slug; requires state.

page.title: Page
page.description: 1-based result page. Beyond the last page returns a non-billable 404.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: Umkreis in km: 0, 10, 25, 50, or 100. Applies when q resolves to a city, or with state + city. Postal codes, Kreise, and states have no Umkreis (non-billable 422 radius_requires_city).
